preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the number of students, k is the number of top scorers, l and r are the minimum and maximum possible scores per student, sall is the total score, and sk is the total score of the top k students.
The minimum score l is less than or equal to the maximum score r.
The number of top scorers k is less than or equal to the total number of students n.
The total score of the top k students sk is less than or equal to the total score sall.

postconditions.expression: len(output_list) == n and all(l <= x <= r for x in output_list)
postconditions.description: The output is a list of exactly n integers, each between l and r inclusive.
The sum of all scores in the output list equals the total score sall.
The sum of the top k scores in the output list equals sk.

repair_issue.instruction: Fix the expression to correctly compute the sum of the top k scores after sorting. The current expression is syntactically invalid (trailing `and` with no right-hand side).
repair_issue.task_evidence: the total score of the k members of the team who scored the most points is equal to exactly sk; more formally, if a1, a2, ..., an is the sequence of points earned by the team of students in the non-increasing order (a1 ≥ a2 ≥ ... ≥ an), then sk = a1 + a2 + ... + ak.
